data.narrative:
Realta Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company that has raised $36M+ to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms, including stage-adjacent players Fuse Energy, Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage, adjacent-stage, or valuation-tier clustering to support a reliable peer-median approach.

Given data constraints, stage-progression anchors the analysis. Using the $36M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-round progression yields an implied valuation of $72M. This method is the only applicable triangulation technique with sufficient support.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $61M to $83M (median $72M), with the range reflecting ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. The primary uncertainty is the absence of granular private comparables at identical stage and valuation tier, which limits validation of the step-up multiplier. Resolution requires either additional private market data or observing Realta's next funding event to calibrate stage-to-stage progression in the nuclear subsector.
